name: Utsumi Chiharu
source: Originally from Kasuga High School, this kid is a genius student and a talented soccer player who aims to become a doctor in the future. Girls confess to him all the time, but he doesn't seem to have any interest in romance. He's always cool and mature, but he's still only 17. Could there be a hidden innocent side to him as well? It's up to you to find out!
